svg.title: A forecast that means what it says
svg.desc: Real bins from the Oklahoma tornado ledger: the worst misses the band. Steps: 1. On the diagonal, a forecast comes true as often as it says. 2. The seasonal tornado model, scored on Oklahoma counties. 3. The contract allows 5 points either side of the line. 4. Its worst bin misses by 7.7 points. 5. Skill and discrimination pass, and calibration fails the card. Sources: The Readiness Loop README; tornado-ok ledger, card exp-0002.

text.tspan: On the diagonal, a forecast comes true as often as it says.
The seasonal tornado model, scored on Oklahoma counties.
The contract allows 5 points either side of the line.
Its worst bin misses by 7.7 points.
Skill and discrimination pass, and calibration fails the card.
Real bins from the Oklahoma tornado ledger: the worst misses the band.
